title: media_db: duplicate identical SELECT_COLS constants
description: In fieldwork-db/src/media_db.rs lines 78-81, SELECT_COLS_PG and SELECT_COLS_SQ are defined as separate constants with identical content. Unlike articles_db which needs different row-mapping functions for pg vs sqlite (due to boolean handling), media_db uses the same tuple type and same columns for both. These should be a single SELECT_COLS constant, matching the pattern in audio_db (TRACK_COLS, CHANNEL_COLS) and books_db (BOOK_COLS, REVIEW_COLS).
close_reason: Fixed: SELECT_COLS_PG and SELECT_COLS_SQ merged into single SELECT_COLS constant
